title: UNIVERSAL INSULATED FLAT ROOF SYSTEM
subtitle: WARM FLAT ROOF WITH PIR INSULATION AND FLEXIBLE WATERPROOFING OPTIONS
metaTitle: Universal Insulated Flat Roof System | EcoViva Mallorca
metaDescription: Warm flat-roof guidance for Mallorca using PIR insulation, continuous vapour control and flexible waterproofing systems.
overview: The universal warm flat roof combines a structural timber deck, continuous vapour control, aluminium-faced PIR insulation and a durable waterproofing system. Different waterproofing materials can be selected according to roof geometry, exposure, detailing and project requirements.
overviewNote: Final design must verify structure, falls, drainage, wind uplift, vapour control, insulation, waterproofing compatibility, penetrations, perimeters and fire requirements.
why: One point of contact from concept to completion
layers: Primary roof structure sized for the project spans and loads.
Rigid load-bearing deck providing a stable roof substrate.
Continuous vapour-control layer below the insulation.
High-performance rigid insulation forming a continuous thermal layer.
Selected membrane forming the durable weather-exposed roof covering.
Falls, drains, flashings and edge profiles direct water safely away.
principles: Seal the vapour barrier at laps, penetrations and perimeter connections.
Keep the insulation layer uninterrupted to reduce thermal bridging.
Provide sufficient falls toward outlets without persistent ponding.
Use primers, membranes, adhesives and accessories as one system.
Detail edges, upstands, drains, rooflights and services carefully.
Verify wind uplift, fire performance, condensation and fixings.
componentsTitle: EXAMPLES OF COMPONENTS USED IN THE SYSTEM
componentsIntro: Components are selected for the deck, insulation, waterproofing, geometry, exposure and project requirements.
components: Edge trim with fascia and drip.
Formed metal for junctions and upstands.
Primary member sized for roof loads.
optionsIntro: Select the waterproofing for the geometry, substrate, exposure, detailing, maintenance and project requirements.
options: Two-layer torch-on system with robust, established detailing.
Reinforced EPDM with bituminous backing and welded joints.
Flexible rubber membrane with strong weather and UV resistance.
Lightweight thermoplastic membrane with welded seams.
Recyclable thermoplastic membrane resistant to heat and UV.
Seamless PMMA or PU solution for complex details and repairs.
serviceLife: Performance depends on system choice, preparation, detailing, drainage, exposure and maintenance. Compatibility, joints, repairability and roof access must be reviewed.
requirements: Verify joist sizing, deck condition and structural capacity.
Provide continuous falls to correctly sized outlets.
Seal vapour-control laps, penetrations and perimeters.
Use compatible primers, membranes and accessories.
Secure perimeters and corners for wind uplift.
Detail drains, upstands, rooflights and penetrations.
Coordinate edge profiles, flashings and façades.
Avoid trapped water and persistent ponding.
Confirm fire, maintenance and access requirements.
Allow for Mallorca sun, coast and intense rainfall.
Follow the CTE, product data and project requirements.
